story.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang pushes back on AI job fears, claims AI is creating enormous number of jobs
story.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly disputed widespread fears that AI is a net job killer, arguing instead that AI is generating a large number of new roles. His comments come as worker anxiety about AI-driven displacement is near an all-time high globally. Critics note that Huang's position as head of the world's leading AI chip company creates a significant conflict of interest in making such assessments.
